description: Ignite Your Navratri Spirit with Pancham Beats' Bay Area Garba, Raas & Dandia Night 2026
long_description:
Ignite Your Navratri Spirit with Pancham Beats' Bay Area Garba, Raas & Dandia Night 2026
Mark your calendars for the electrifying evening of October 15th, 2026. Pancham Beats invites you to immerse yourself in a night filled with live music, pulsating beats, and invincible energy at our Bay Area Garba, Raas & Dandia Night. A must-attend for all Gujarati and Multilingual music enthusiasts, this event promises an unforgettable celebration of Navratri/Dandiya traditions set to the rhythm of our vibrant, multicultural community.
Meet the Maestro: Dhawal Majmudar
Behind the captivating melodies and heart-thumping beats of Pancham Beats is the seasoned vocalist and musician, Dhawal Majmudar. With a career spanning over a decade, Dhawal has established a reputation as one of the most versatile and entertaining performers in the Bay Area. His performances, marked by a rich blend of Indian musical traditions and contemporary sounds, have endeared him to audiences of all ages. Whether it's Garba, Dandiya, Bhajans, Indian Folk, Bollywood, or Ghazals, Dhawal's mastery over diverse genres is truly impressive. Moreover, his unique talent for voice impressions, notably his remarkable rendition of Amitabh Bachchan, adds a delightful twist to his performances, making him a crowd favourite at every event.
Experience the Magic at SHUBHAM HALLS
SHUBHAM HALLS, located at 1214 Apollo Way in Sunnyvale, CA, United States, is the chosen venue for this grand celebration. Known for its accessibility and safety, the venue provides the perfect ambiance for an evening of fun and frolic. To add to your convenience, ample parking spaces are available at the venue. And if you wish to treat your taste buds to some authentic Indian cuisine before or after the event, several Indian restaurants are situated in close proximity to the venue.
Grab Your Tickets Today!
Don't miss out on this exciting event. General Admission tickets are priced at just $15.00. Secure your tickets today and get ready to dance the night away at the Bay Area Garba, Raas & Dandia Night 2026.
